highlights: The Green Lion Active SE Smart Watch is a stunning and easy-to-wear watch with distinctive looks combined with functionality and fashion.
The solid strap is held within a nicely crafted alloy vacuum-plated watch case, giving it an air of grit and advanced taste.
All those connections are provided with a mobile handset, which is compatible with Bluetooth 5.0 and can easily handle any information you need, including Bluetooth calls and meetings.
Its 250mAh battery can be replenished through wireless charging, which in return can get the device functional for 10 days on standby mode in approximately six hours.
This smart wristwatch has additional resistance as its IP67 rating allows it to be worn even while engaging in daily activities and sports.
Some more high-end features include the always-on display, double-tap gesture, and support for many NFC cards, which engage the users more and make them easy to work with.

With such hints as fitness tracking to social usage, etc. It is clear that the Green Lion Active SE Smart Watch provides technologically advanced devices with fashion, which is the best about a wearable accessory
